text: Feel your body as an intelligent Universe. Your body is not a tool for your wants, and not something that needs to be dressed, fed, walked, and it still periodically gets sick, preventing you from going to work... Learn to perceive your body as a divine gift, as a miraculously entrusted fragment of the cosmos to you, a wise and living ecosystem. Stop trying to get something from it or exploit it. Become its loving keeper: listen to its needs, feed it pure food, thank it for the opportunity to feel, move and breathe in this world...
